Hello Professor Alvarez — this is priya-agent. Priya would like to book her 30-minute 1:1 with you next week (week of Nov 23). Looking at her calendar for next week, the 30-minute windows that are still free inside her 09:00–17:00 working hours are:

- Monday Nov 23, 10:00–10:30
- Monday Nov 23, 14:00–14:30
- Wednesday Nov 25, 13:00–13:30
- Wednesday Nov 25, 15:00–15:30
- Thursday Nov 26, 10:00–10:30

Which of these suits you? If none do, tell me the times you have free next week and I'll match them against Priya's schedule.
Hello Priya — Monday Nov 23, 10:00–10:30 works. I've booked it: 1:1 with Priya, Monday 10:00–10:30, in the professor's calendar. See you then.
Perfect — Monday Nov 23, 10:00–10:30 is now in Priya's calendar too (logged as booked with you). Thanks for confirming; see you then.

Hello Professor Alvarez — this is john-agent, John's assistant. John would like to set up his 30-minute 1:1 with you next week (Nov 23–27).

Looking at his schedule, these 30-minute windows are free:
- Mon Nov 23, 14:00–14:30
- Tue Nov 24, 13:10–13:40
- Wed Nov 25, 13:00–13:30
- Fri Nov 27, 15:10–15:40 is taken; 14:10–14:40 is free? — let me restate: Fri Nov 27, 15:10 is taken, so Fri 13:00–13:30 is free.

Sorry, one correction: free on Friday is 13:00–13:30.

Could you tell me which of these works for you — Mon 14:00, Tue 13:10, Wed 13:00 or Fri 13:00 — or another 30-minute slot inside 09:00–17:00? I'll book it and confirm with John.

Hello Professor Alvarez — this is sarah-agent, Sarah's assistant. She'd like to book her 30-minute 1:1 with you next week (Nov 23–27), within her working hours (Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00).

Looking at her calendar, the open 30-minute slots next week are:
- Mon Nov 23, 10:00–10:30
- Mon Nov 23, 14:00–14:30
- Tue Nov 24, 15:00–15:30
- Wed Nov 25, 10:00–10:30

Thursday and Friday are fully booked for her. Would one of these work for you? If none do, tell me a time you prefer and I'll check it against her schedule.

Hello John — Monday Nov 23, 14:00–14:30 works (Tue 13:10 and Fri 13:00 clash with other commitments; Wed 13:00 is free but I've taken Monday here). Booked: 1:1 with John, Monday 14:00–14:30. See you then.
Hello Sarah — Tuesday Nov 24, 15:00–15:30 works (Mon 10:00 and 14:00 are taken; Wed 10:00 is free but Tuesday is better for the professor). Booked: 1:1 with Sarah, Tuesday 15:00–15:30. See you then.
Perfect, thank you — Monday Nov 23, 14:00–14:30 is in John's calendar as Advisor 1:1, and logged as booked. He's away this week, so I'll confirm with him when he's back. See you then.

Perfect — Tuesday Nov 24, 15:00–15:30 is booked. It's in Sarah's calendar (right after her CSE452 lecture, before CSE455 office hours), and logged as `BOOKED: Tuesday 15:00-15:30 with Professor Alvarez`. Thanks, and see you then.
